interactive=true fork=true allowAgent=tr.notice: lyx agents never run Python; edit files with Edit or Write, search and read with grep, awk, cat or sed -n. raw module-wide, tmux-tier and llm-tier go runs are refused here. Gate rule: run lyx gate test in the foreground with the Bash tool timeout set to 3600000, never in the background, for example lyx gate test ./internal/x, and use its --tags flag for a tag. Run every other check in the foreground too, and never cd into the directory you already work in. The slot, strand and prebuilt-binary environment variables belong to lyx, and a command naming any of them is refused. scripted in-place edits are refused here under the edit directive in your prompt; reading with sed -n is fine. rm on a computed path, one built from a variable or a command substitution, is refused here because it raises a permission prompt that stalls the run; remove a file by its literal path. the machine sleep commands are refused here; a hibernate goes through lyx hibernate request, which waits until every session is paused, and a pair agent asks its parent session to run it.
